intent: A dark invoice list for one workspace. Paid, open and failed are distinct without a rainbow, a filter with counts narrows the list, amounts are tabular, and a download turns into a drawn check. Below 448px the table becomes cards.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4; colour tokens as CSS variables on the root (--inv-surface, --inv-raised, --inv-track, --inv-ink, --inv-muted, --inv-accent, --inv-accent-text)
stack.animation: motion/react for the entrance, the filter pill, the list height and the check
stack.icons: none; the download arrow and the saved check are inline SVG
stack.fonts: font-display (Geist) for the heading; font-sans for rows; font-mono for the eyebrow, filter counts and the tally

layout.header: mono BILLING, 22px heading Invoices, a line for the open total
layout.filter: four equal chips in a capsule: All, Paid, Open, Failed, each with a count
layout.table: from a card width of 448px: Invoice, Issued, Status, Amount, and a 44px download
layout.cards: below 448px: id, date and status on the left, amount and download on the right, 14px radius, 8px gap
layout.tally: mono line, right aligned, showing how many of the ledger the filter left

typography.label: mono 11px, weight 500, uppercase, tracking 0.08em, muted
typography.heading: font-display 22px, weight 600, tracking -0.025em, leading 1.1
typography.rows: table id and amount 14px medium; card id and amount 15px medium; dates 13 to 13.5px muted tabular

color.approach: greys with one accent prop (default #7dd3a8) for an open invoice, the open total and a saved download; paid is muted; failed is ink, not red
color.accentText: on light, color-mix(in oklch, accent 45%, ink)

motion.entrance: header, filter at 80ms, list at 160ms; rise 10px out of an 8px blur over 500ms, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), then filter cleared
motion.filter: the selected chip's pill springs (stiffness 500, damping 40); the list fades and rises 6px; its height eases over 320ms
motion.download: the icon swaps over 180ms; the check draws over 320ms; the button fills with the accent; press scale 0.97
motion.reducedMotion: opacity only; the pill jumps; the check is already drawn; height changes instantly

responsive.390: cards, not a table; the four filter chips stay on one row; the download stays 44px
responsive.1440: a 560px card with a real table; the amount column is right aligned

accessibility: the filter is a radiogroup; arrow keys, Home and End move the selection and focus
the table has a caption and column headers; each invoice id is a row header
narrow widths use a list instead of the table
the download button is named with the invoice id, and the name changes once it is saved
2px ink focus outlines with a 2px offset, keyboard only

content.subtitle: 1 open · $48.00
content.demo: filter to Open, then download INV-1046, which is the only row left and turns into a check

avoid: a different colour for each status
a modal to confirm the download
making the whole row the download control
